_note: Batch 2: ten REAL Perth practices researched from public information on 7 Aug 2026. Descriptions are original copy. All unclaimed, no ratings copied. Verify each against its website before publishing — per-listing confirmation notes in _source.

categories.name: Meditation classes
categories.blurb: Drop-in sittings, guided courses and beginner-friendly evening classes.

categories.name: Breathwork
categories.blurb: Conscious connected breathing, pranayama and nervous-system reset work.

categories.name: Yoga & movement
categories.blurb: Yin, hatha, restorative and slow-flow studios with a mindfulness focus.

categories.name: Mindfulness coaching
categories.blurb: One-to-one coaching, MBSR courses and workplace mindfulness programs.

categories.name: Sound & float
categories.blurb: Sound baths, gong journeys, float tanks and sensory recovery rooms.

categories.name: Retreats & day escapes
categories.blurb: Half-day resets through to weekend retreats within a drive of Perth.

listings.name: Fremantle Yoga Centre
listings.blurb: One of Perth's longest-standing yoga studios, running morning vinyasa, hatha, beginners, therapy yoga, restorative yin and mum-and-bubs classes from Petra Street. Occasional sound bath evenings round out a timetable built for regulars rather than drop-in tourists.
listings._source: fremantleyoga.com — address, email, class styles, Punchpass booking confirmed; casual price not published

listings.name: Yogahub Perth
listings.blurb: More than thirty-six classes a week across Ashtanga, Iyengar, Vinyasa, Hatha and Yin, seven days a week — including Mysore-style self-practice from 5.30am for the before-work crowd. The six-week Beginners Foundations course is the structured way in if you've never stepped on a mat.
listings._source: yogahubperth.com.au — address, phone, email, styles, class volume confirmed; casual price not published

listings.name: Kadampa Meditation Centre Perth
listings.blurb: A not-for-profit centre teaching modern Buddhist meditation, with its home in East Fremantle and weekly drop-in classes across the metro — Joondalup, Kingsley, Bayswater, Baldivis and free lunchtime sessions at the WA Museum. Drop-ins are $15, need no booking, and assume no background whatsoever.
listings._source: meditateinperth.org — branch structure, $15 drop-in, free museum class confirmed; STREET ADDRESS NEEDS VERIFYING before publish

listings.name: Add Goodness
listings.blurb: Breathwork and recovery studios on Beaufort Street (with a second room in Booragoon), running group breathwork, sound healing, yin, yoga nidra and slow flow alongside sauna and ice-bath contrast work. The $79 two-week unlimited intro is one of the better ways in the city to find out which of those actually suits you.
listings._source: addgoodness.org — both addresses, phone, class mix, intro and membership pricing confirmed

listings.name: Float Lab
listings.blurb: Float tanks on Cambridge Street, paired with infrared sauna and relaxation, remedial and pregnancy massage — with a sister site in Currambine for the northern corridor. Floating is the practice here rather than a bolt-on, and the booking system makes a first session painless.
listings._source: floatlab.com.au — address, phone, email, services confirmed; single-float price not on homepage

listings.name: Salt Float Studio
listings.blurb: Flotation and recovery on the Canning Highway: 45, 60 and 90-minute floats (including pregnancy floats), infrared sauna, red-light therapy and contrast plunge combos. Sixty minutes in the salt runs $85, with five-packs and memberships for people who make it a habit.
listings._source: saltfloatstudio.com.au — address, phone, email, full price list and hours confirmed

listings.name: Restful Waters
listings.blurb: Sound baths in the hills above Armadale — fortnightly Sunday sonic immersions plus sunset, full-moon and cacao-ceremony sessions, with mats, bolsters and blankets provided. The bush setting is half the experience, and a three-event pass suits people who want it as a regular reset rather than a one-off.
listings._source: restfulwaters.org — address, phone, email, session types and cadence confirmed; per-session price not listed

listings.name: Mindful EAS
listings.blurb: Karen Haddon teaches the full eight-week MBSR program — weekly 2.5-hour classes plus a seven-hour retreat day — in person and online, alongside Mindful Self-Compassion, workplace and schools programs, and one-to-one coaching. The course runs $695 with payment plans and hardship rates offered without fuss, and a free fifteen-minute consult settles whether it's the right fit.
listings._source: mindfuleas.com.au — facilitator, course format, $695 fee, contact confirmed; venue suburb not published

listings._force_reason: Shares bswa.org with Dhammaloka Buddhist Centre — same organisation, different venue 50km apart. Not a duplicate.
listings.name: Jhana Grove Meditation Retreat Centre
listings.blurb: The Buddhist Society of WA's purpose-built retreat centre in a Darling Scarp valley beside Bodhinyana Monastery — sixty single rooms with ensuites, a large meditation hall and covered walking-meditation halls. Weekend and nine-day residential retreats are led by monastics, with long days of sitting and walking practice; experienced practitioners can arrange mentored self-retreats of a week or more.
listings._source: bswa.org — address, phone, email, capacity, retreat formats confirmed

listings.name: Perth Meditation Centre
listings.blurb: Eric Harrison has taught meditation in Perth since 1987 — some twenty-five thousand students on — with an approach that is deliberately rational and practical, free of spiritual framing. Day-long mindfulness workshops run one Saturday a month ($210, $150 concession) and include his textbook and guided audio for home practice.
